triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:spec` (lint rule `form-view-internal-not-loaded`) and `domain:ui` (Studio Interfaces rail) · `pm:queue`, to claim after PR #36543 merges (the body has no `Blocked-by:` line); rationale: area:build (writing metadata) · Bug · after #36425, the new advisory rule and the Studio rail call a default or `OBJECT.create` form internal whenever sharing is off, although a `form`-type action can still open it by name. The advisory tells an author a live form is unused, and an author who trusts it and removes the form breaks the action. Stale `resolveFormViewLayout` comments and checklist recipes ride along. l2-review#4 nits N2 and N3 → p2 as the seat suggested · size S. Topic #36359. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7084683028).

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

First concrete case for N2, from l2-review#4 delta 7086190847 on PR #36543 (nit N4): `examples/app-showcase` `showcase_task · form` is the task object's default form. Three actions open it by name: `showcase_log_time`, `showcase_new_task`, and the Overview's Create Task. `FormPage` still loads it, so it is reachable. The new rule still warns that it is "no longer loaded", and PR #36543 allowlists that warning. Pin this case when N2 is fixed. #36553 (example-app migration) leaves this one form alone until N2 is decided here.
